| difficulty = 2
}}{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Rice|Rice]]

'''Microwave risotto''' is made using the [[Cookbook:Microwave Oven|microwave]]. It requires very little stirring and turns out quite well.

==Ingredients==
*3 [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] (750 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|ml]]/1.6 [[Cookbook:Pint|pints]]) simmering hot [[Cookbook:Chicken Broth|chicken broth]]
*½ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
*1 dash ground white or black [[Cookbook:Pepper|pepper]]
*2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoons]] [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]]
*2 tablespoons [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|olive oil]]
*½ cup (90 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]]/3.2 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]]) [[Cookbook:Mince|minced]] yellow [[Cookbook:Onion|onion]]
*1 cup (125 g/4.4 oz) uncooked medium grain [[Cookbook:Rice|rice]]

==Procedure==

#In a [[Cookbook:Saucepan|saucepan]], bring chicken broth, salt and pepper to a low [[Cookbook:Simmering|simmer]], and keep warm until needed.
#In an {{convert/3|8|x|8|x|2|in|cm|adj=on}} oven-proof dish (or 10-inch/25 cm [[Cookbook:Quiche|quiche]] dish), heat oil and butter in microwave for 2 minutes.
#Add minced onion to the dish, stir to coat with oil, and cook in microwave for 4 minutes.
#Add uncooked rice to the dish, stir to coat with oil, and cook in microwave for another 4 minutes.
#Pour simmering chicken broth into the dish and stir well. Microwave 9 minutes.
#Stir rice and chicken broth well and microwave another 9 minutes.
#If a creamier risotto is desired, add ¼ cup ({{convert|60|ml|USoz|disp=s}}) warm water, stir well and microwave for another 2 minutes. 

==Notes, tips, and variations==

*For a 750-watt microwave, use 100% power settings for each time interval. For 1000 or 1500-watt microwaves, use 70% power settings for each time interval.
*As a variation, use 2½ cups ({{convert|625|ml|USpt|disp=s}}) chicken broth and ½ cup ({{convert|125|ml|USoz|disp=s}}) white wine.
*Freshly-grated Parmesan cheese may also be added after cooking.
